{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Fix revenue: strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:")
print(qa_orders)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check if any QA orders are in the filtered group
qa_in_filtered = filtered_df[filtered_df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("\nQA orders in NEW paid_search group:")
print(qa_in_filtered)

# Exclude QA orders from the filtered group
filtered_no_qa = filtered_df[filtered_df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Recompute conversion rate
n_total = len(filtered_no_qa)
n_converted = filtered_no_qa['converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_total

# Print results
print(f"Total NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH (excluding QA): {n_total}")
print(f"Converted (excluding QA): {n_converted}")
print(f"Fraction converted (excluding QA): {fraction_converted}")

# Output the fraction as a float between 0 and 1
fraction_converted"}
